kebab_example: aliyun iot delete-speech --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --speech-code-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteSpeech

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看您的实例ID。
><notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
></notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the speech corpora to delete. You can obtain the corpus ID from the **Corpus Configuration** console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217571.html and use the **Data** field returned upon success as the corpus ID.

N is an integer. Valid values: 1 to 20. This indicates that a maximum of 20 corpora can be deleted at a time
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的语料ID，您可以在**语料配置**控制台获取语料ID，或者调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217571.html，成功后返回的**Data**字段为语料ID。

N为整数，取值范围：1~20，表示每次最多删除20条
